response_firewall: Stage-A scores use public study/archive descriptions only. Published effect direction, p-value, fitted coefficient, and project-computed outcome association are not scoring fields.

systems.gate_reason: The source design explicitly measures landscape/local management, direct pollinator visitation and fruit/seed production at orchard scale across 20 orchards, and identifies an open Zenodo deposit. The public article establishes the biological design, but the exact deposited file/column/join schema has not yet been independently verified by this project, so reusable O/I/F/A are not promoted to yes.

systems.setting: Balearic Islands Cneorum tricoccon-Podarcis lilfordi system
systems.gate_reason: Dryad publicly exposes separate pollination-census and fruits/seeds files, so direct process and realised reproduction are demonstrably co-archived. A common ecological join key and independent holdout count still require schema inspection, and no comparable upstream fragmentation/landscape context coordinate is preregistered for a residual-context test.

systems.setting: Mallorca coastal plant community, 23 abundant plant species across two field seasons
systems.gate_reason: Dryad contains a workbook for the 23-species/two-season study, and the public dataset description explicitly includes floral abundance, pollination-network information, seeds per flower and seed weight. Exact direct-visitation and species-year join columns still require workbook schema inspection. Species are potential process-function holdout units within one system, not 23 independent island systems.

The open source study measures orchard management/landscape context, visitation and fruit/seed/apple outcomes at six orchards. Public article/supplement access demonstrates the study design but has not yet demonstrated to this project a reusable same-orchard row-level join table, so Stage A remains partial pending schema inspection.
